label: Tue, Sep 29
title: Sep 29 Daily Summary
speech:
Gather round, gather round. Grab a water, grab a seat, grab a teammate's shoulder if you need it.

6 matches. 2 wins, 2 draws, 2 losses. 10 goals for, 13 against. Those are the facts, and facts are friends, even the grumpy ones.

And that 4-3 against FC Creamsters? That was football the way grandma makes pie: all the right ingredients, and plenty of love. We also have to talk about Abdina fc. 1-4. That one's sitting in my stomach like a gas-station burrito. Nobody's hanging their head tonight. We had our moments, we had our mistakes, and both of 'em are information. Good coaches love information almost as much as biscuits.

There were stretches out there where we looked like a real team, and stretches where we looked like eleven strangers at a bus stop. The goal is more of the first one.

BellyTb1: 6 goals, 2 assists, 5 key passes, 8.0 average. You were the steady heartbeat of this team today. And PhogsToffees, 4 goals, 4 assists, 12 key passes and a 7.8 average over 6 games. Don't you dare let anybody tell you that didn't matter.

I loved watching BellyTb1 and PhogsToffees link up, 10 goals between 'em. Partnerships like that are the backbone of a team.

Back home there's a diner that burns the first pancake every single morning, on purpose. Says it seasons the pan. Today might've been our first pancake.

If we work on one thing, let it be forcing passes. Here's how: Below about 72% the extra passes start costing us. Pick the simple option until the touch comes back.

We're not far off. We're a couple of good decisions a match from turning draws into wins and losses into draws. That's a short walk, y'all.

We're closer than the scoreboard says. Rest up. Tomorrow we take another swing, and I like our odds.
key_stats: Player of the day: BellyTb1 (8.0 avg, 6 goals, 2 assists)
